content: {"like":["Enjoys inventive time‑travel plots with quirky twists and well‑developed characters in period settings","Prefers raunchy, silly humor and absurd cameos in action‑comedy hybrids","Values high‑stakes action and epic chase sequences with realistic CGI in sci‑fi blockbusters","Appreciates heartfelt humor and emotional core in animated Lego‑style films","Loves clever parody moments that subvert classic hero tropes in comedic sci‑fi"],"dislike":["Dislikes poorly written, logically weak scripts with flat characters in low‑budget dramas","Rejects over‑reliance on CGI that undermines story depth in action films","Criticizes films that use offensive stereotypes or gratuitous racial humor","Disapproves of films with confusing, poorly defined plots and lack of clear goals","Avoids movies with excessive nudity, inappropriate shots, or low‑quality animation"]}
